decks.notes: The deck focuses on assembling the combo of Lotus Field and untap effects to generate large amounts of mana quickly and efficiently. By utilizing cards like Hidden Strings, Vizier of Tumbling Sands, and Pore Over the Pages, the deck can power out powerful spells like Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience. The inclusion of various utility lands and card draw spells helps ensure that the combo pieces come together smoothly, while also providing flexibility and resilience against disruption. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big plays and outmaneuver them through intricate decision-making.

The main focus of this UW Control deck is to slow down the opponent's strategy while generating card advantage and control the game through counterspells, board wipes, and card draw. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Discontinuity while constantly refilling its hand with cards like Memory Deluge and Farewell. Shark Typhoon provides a win condition in the late game, and cards like Joint Exploration allow for mana ramping to cast powerful spells like Ondu Inversion and Finale of Revelation. The deck also includes a variety of utility lands to support its control strategy.

This UW Control deck focuses on countering and controlling opponent's spells while generating card advantage and creating tokens. The deck utilizes cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Memory Deluge to draw cards and keep the board under control. The deck also includes cards like Discontinuity and The Wandering Emperor to disrupt opponent's plans and finish the game with a powerful finisher like Shark Typhoon or Dream Trawler. The mana base is designed to support the control elements of the deck with lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Hengegate Pathway.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana through green devotion creatures and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, enabling powerful plays like casting multiple spells in a turn or using Karn, the Great Creator to shut down opposing strategies. The deck also aims to generate card advantage with cards like Storm the Festival and Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner, while also maintaining board presence with efficient threats like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. Lair of the Hydra and Polukranos Reborn provide additional late-game threats to close out the game.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly developing a wide board presence using efficient creatures like Burning-Tree Emissary, Thraben Inspector, and Venerated Loxodon, supported by cheap artifacts like Ornithopter. The deck also utilizes powerful anthems like Resolute Reinforcements and Legion Loyalist to pump up the team and overwhelm the opponent. With a low mana curve and aggressive game plan, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and finish off the opponent before they can stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Gleeful Demolition provides additional reach and removal options to secure victory.

This deck focuses on sacrificing creatures to trigger powerful effects and control the board, while utilizing Jegantha as a companion for additional value. By combining cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, and Claim the Firstborn with efficient removal spells like Fatal Push, the deck aims to pressure opponents and disrupt their game plan. With a mix of aggressive threats like Kroxa and Bloodtithe Harvester, along with utility lands like Den of the Bugbear and Hive of the Eye Tyrant, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents through constant sacrifice synergies and versatile threats.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to apply constant pressure and deal damage efficiently to control the pace of the game. With a focus on speed and aggression, the deck utilizes cards that can quickly deal damage to the opponent's life total while using creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Soul-Scar Mage to present early threats. Additionally, the inclusion of Chained to the Rocks provides removal options to clear the way for continued attacks.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal spells, and planeswalkers, particularly Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. It also utilizes cards like Discontinuity and Shark Typhoon to disrupt opponents' plans and create threats. By using cards like Supreme Verdict and Memory Deluge, the deck aims to maintain board control and card advantage. The mana base includes cards like Lotus Field and Hengegate Pathway to ensure consistent access to different colors of mana. Overall, the deck aims to outlast opponents through careful control of the game.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with cards like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic to play powerful threats early on. The creatures in this deck have aggressive stats and abilities, allowing for fast damage output. Cards like The Akroan War and Reckless Stormseeker help to control the board and push through damage. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional flexibility and a powerful late-game option. Overall, this deck aims to pressure the opponent early and maintain a strong board presence throughout the game.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage provided by Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan by countering key spells and removing threats with cards like Supreme Verdict and Portable Hole. The win condition is either through incremental advantage with cards like Shark Typhoon or through a late-game threat like Hall of Storm Giants. The deck also utilizes utility lands like Field of Ruin and Castle Ardenvale to further control the battlefield and outvalue the opponent.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on deploying efficient threats early on and attacking aggressively to overwhelm the opponent. The deck utilizes mana dorks like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic to ramp into powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Lovestruck Beast. Skysovereign, Consul Flagship provides additional removal and pressure in the air, while cards like The Akroan War and Reckless Stormseeker help maintain board control and push damage through. With a mix of creatures, removal, and powerful lands like Mutavault and Lair of the Hydra, this deck aims to close out games quickly with relentless aggression.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle. The deck includes a mix of low-cost creatures and removal spells to pressure the opponent and maintain board control. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional flexibility and mana ramping options. The deck aims to quickly build a strong board presence and deal damage to the opponent efficiently, using cards like Showdown of the Skalds and Chained to the Rocks to generate value and maintain momentum.

This deck focuses on flooding the board with small, aggressive creatures to overwhelm the opponent quickly. Using cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, the deck boosts the power of its weenie creatures and enables them to deal significant damage. Protection spells like Brave the Elements help to ensure the creatures can attack freely, while cards like Ossification provide removal options. The inclusion of Mutavault and Castle Ardenvale adds extra versatility and resilience to the deck, making it difficult for opponents to handle the relentless assault of the white weenie creatures.

This Izzet Control deck focuses on maintaining control of the game through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. By efficiently answering threats and drawing into more resources, the deck aims to outvalue opponents and eventually win through powerful finishers like Crackling Drake. With a mix of cheap interactive spells and versatile threats, the deck can adapt to a variety of matchups and playstyles, seeking to outmaneuver opponents and emerge victorious in the end.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced aggressive strategy focused on building up green mana devotion. By utilizing cards like Llanowar Elves, Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, and Elvish Mystic to ramp up mana quickly, the deck aims to cast powerful green creatures such as Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. Additionally, cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival provide additional value and utility. The deck also includes powerful lands like Lair of the Hydra and Boseiju, Who Endures to further enhance the green devotion strategy.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by using counterspells, board wipes, and card draw to maintain board presence and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value through blinking permanents for extra ETB triggers. With a mix of removal, card advantage engines, and late-game finishers like Shark Typhoon and Teferi, Hero of Dominaria, this deck aims to control the pace of the game and grind out incremental advantages until it can secure a win.
